            values = spl.ev(full_y, full_x)

- Modified `satpy/readers/slstr_l1b.py` in the `NCSLSTRAngles` class to apply `values % 360` if "azimuth" is in the variable name.
- Verified the change by running existing tests in `satpy/tests/reader_tests/test_slstr_l1b.py`.
